name: head
purpose: Display the first lines (default 10) of a file or piped command output.
explanation: Referenced in C07 alongside `strings` to print just the opening lines of readable output from a file or pipeline.

parameters.description: Print the first `<count>` lines instead of the default 10.

explanationOfOutput: Stops reading after printing the first 5 lines.
whenToUse: To preview the start of a large file or trim long piped output.
commonMistakes: Using `cat` on a massive log file when you only need the first few lines.
commonErrors: head: server.log: No such file or directory
